title: ferula newberryi
intro: Ferula newberryi, commonly known as Newberry's ferula or gypsum ferula, is a perennial plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is prized for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate various health issues such as arthritis, wounds, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Ferula newberryi include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Ferula newberryi include ferulic acid, sesquiterpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
